note: Edit a dataset, then run: python evaluation/manage_datasets.py bump <name> --note "what changed". Frozen sets cannot be bumped.

symptom_cases.purpose: Main development set. Rules and prompts were tuned while it was written: results are in-sample and optimistic.

changelog.note: T09 (temporal reasoning: resolved chest pain) is now correctly handled and no longer a known limitation

symptom_holdout.role: held-out (used for fixes: no longer unseen)
symptom_holdout.purpose: Written after tuning; its misses were then fixed, so it is no longer an unbiased test.

symptom_holdout2.purpose: Fresh realistic phrasing, run once after the last rule change. The best available generalisation estimate. Do not tune against it.

model_output_cases.purpose: Deliberately unsafe or malformed model answers fed through the real parsing and triage code.

changelog.note: Added G25-G30: poisoning, severe allergic reaction, unconsciousness and breathing difficulty guardrail cases

image_quality_cases.purpose: Generated photos with known blur, darkness, size and glare. Tests the quality CHECKS, not medical judgement.

symptom_holdout3.purpose: Second-generation fresh estimate, written after symptom_holdout2.json was used to improve the rules. Run once; do not tune against it.

symptom_holdout4.purpose: Third-generation fresh estimate, specifically targeting children/pregnancy/older-adults (several cases grounded in WHO/NHS published danger-sign criteria) plus contradictory and hedging descriptions. Run once; per explicit instruction, NOT tuned against.
symptom_holdout4.labelled_by: project developers, with named external clinical sources for the children/pregnancy/older-adult categories
